set.approach: The Chocolate Chip is a small block just west of The Cleft, directly across a gap from the Paiute Pockets route on the Cleft wall. Park at the hairpin bend in the aspen grove on Hinkey Summit Road and follow the faint foot track east toward the big Cleft wall; it crosses two drainages before reaching the base. Miner Whipper is on the east side of the block, up the large obvious crack, with a bolted sport start available to the left of it.
set.descent_text: The top anchor has rap rings for rappelling the route. A walk-off also exists on the northwest side of the block; it involves some fourth-class scrambling, and both the rappel and the walk-off require stepping across gaps.

review.notes: Route page: location, rappel rings and walk-off. Chocolate Chip page: walk-off on NW side, rappel rings. Cleft page: parking and hike.

set.approach: Starting at the end of the Lizzie's Basin 4x4 track, walk around the west side of the beaver marsh and climb the rocky slope to the towers. The towers form a southern line, numbered upward from the lowest, and an eastern line. Adam's Bush is on the south face of the S3 tower and begins up vegetated ground toward the golden crack above.

review.notes: Approach from the area page; start from the route page. No descent stated for this route.

set.approach: Starting at the end of the Lizzie's Basin 4x4 track, walk around the west side of the beaver marsh and climb the rocky slope to the towers. Fawn Arete is on the lowest tower of the southern line (S1): look for the broad rocky ledge on its south side, and the route begins at the east end of that ledge.
set.descent_text: Walk off the back of the tower from the top.

review.notes: Route page states start and the walk-off; area page gives the approach.

set.approach: Starting at the end of the Lizzie's Basin 4x4 track, walk south into Weeks Creek Basin, toward the big wall closing off its southern end. The better upper band of the wall is reached by hiking the gully on either side. Damocles' Weekness takes the rightmost arete of the wall, next to the High Sirens ice flows.

review.notes: Approach from the area page; start from the route page. No descent stated.
